assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of Revised Report on the Algorithmic Language ALGOL 68 and inspected the cited passage (§6.2.2 Semantics, printed p. 94 (physical PDF p. 95)). Section 6.2.2 on printed page 94 takes the name yielded by the meek form, requires that it be non-nil, and makes the result the value that name refers to.

challenge.method: Follow the clauses for nil and non-nil names, and compare dereferencing with the adjacent deproceduring and uniting coercions.
challenge.results: Nil fails this requirement. A non-nil name supplies its referred-to value. Deproceduring and uniting have separate semantics on this page and do not alter the dereferencing rule.

limitations: The Bulletin 47 cover authenticates the supplement with authorized errata through 1978. The claim does not infer an implementation-specific nil failure mode.
